sloka: पार्श्वतः पृष्टतश्चास्य सर्वे यूथपाधिपाः स्वयम्।अनुजह्रुर्महाशैलान् विविधांश्च महाद्रुमान् ।। ६.९७.८ ।।
transliteration: pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭataścāsya sarve yūthapādhipāḥ svayam।anujahrurmahāśailān vividhāṁśca mahādrumān ।। 6.97.8 ।।

translations.english: All the leaders of the army themselves seizing hold of huge mountains and trees of several kinds followed his side.
